name: app.R
content:
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)

variants <- read.csv2("variants.csv")[,-1]

lista_SC <- read_delim("alliancemine_results_2026-10-29T18-12-17.tsv",
                       delim = "\t", escape_double = FALSE,
                       col_names = FALSE, trim_ws = TRUE)

grep("*trna*",lista_SC$X2, ignore.case = T) -> ii
lista_TRNASC <- lista_SC[ii,]
orthologs_candida_sifted <- read.delim("orthologs_ids_Candida_sifted",header = F)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Strain Visualizer"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      # The checkbox group is always visible
      checkboxGroupInput(
        inputId = "impacts", 
        label = "Impacts to show:",
        choices = unique(variants$Impact), 
        selected = unique(variants$Impact)
      )
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      # Directly display the table without any tabs
      dataTableOutput("mytable1")
    )
  )
)



server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$mytable1 <- renderDataTable({
    req(input$impacts)
    
    variants_clean <- variants[as.character(variants$Impact) %in% input$impacts, ]
    variantes_relevantes <- variants_clean[variants_clean$Gene_name %in% orthologs_candida_sifted$V1,]
    index <- grep("*_GT",colnames(variantes_relevantes))
    
    var_tbl <- variantes_relevantes[,c(7,index,6)]
    
    aa <- which(var_tbl %in% c("1/1","0/1"),arr.ind = T)
    
    #edit final tbl
    cc <- cbind(
      var_tbl[aa[,1],1,drop = F],
      
      "strain" = colnames(var_tbl)[aa[,2]],
      "genotype" = as.matrix(var_tbl)[aa],
      "IMPACT" = var_tbl[aa[,1],167]
    )
    
    cc
    }
  )
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
